prompt: Add a title saying 'New drop Friday' over the first three seconds, in the upper part of the frame, on top of the video.

checks.why: a text clip with the words, from 0 for about 3 s
in the upper part of the frame
on a video track above the footage (tracks are listed top first)

tracks.$expr: (() => { const t = v.findIndex((tr) => tr.clips.some((c) => c.type === 'text')); const m = v.findIndex((tr) => tr.clips.some((c) => c.id === 'c1')); return t >= 0 && t < m; })()
